description.zh: 待查询CA证书的SN序列码，表示查询哪一个CA证书下所有已注册的设备证书。
description.en: The SN serial number of the CA certificate to be queried, indicating which CA certificate's registered device certificates are to be retrieved.

description.zh: CA证书所绑定的实例ID，即云消息队列 MQTT 版的实例ID。
description.en: The instance ID bound to the CA certificate, which is the instance ID of the MQTT version of the cloud message queue.

description.zh: 查询第几页的返回结果。起始页从第1页开始计算。
description.en: Indicates the page number of the returned results. The starting page is counted from 1.

description.zh:
每页最多显示几条查询记录。

取值范围：1~100。
description.en: The maximum number of query records to display per page. Value range: 1 to 100.

descriptions.zh:
- 仅铂金版<props="china">和专业版</props>实例支持使用ListDeviceCertificateByCaSn接口。
- 单用户请求频率限制为500次/秒。如有特殊需求，请联系云消息队列 MQTT 版技术支持，钉钉群号：35228338。
descriptions.en:
*   Only ApsaraMQ for MQTT Enterprise Platinum Edition instances support this operation.
*   You can call this operation up to 500 times per second per Alibaba Cloud account. If you want to increase the limit, join the DingTalk group (ID: 35228338) to contact ApsaraMQ for MQTT technical support.
